From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.s@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.i@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.p@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: 2026 annual review: timeline, templates, and sensitive-role protocol

Folks —

Drafting this thread to lock the timeline and the protocol for handling sensitive roles during the upcoming 2026 review cycle. Key goals: keep cycle on a single schedule, minimize disclosure risk for payroll/privileged roles, and give managers a clear, short toolkit.

High level proposal (attached: 2026_review_packet_v1.docx):
- Timeline: manager calibration + calibration packet sent 2026-10-04; manager review window 2026-10-11 -> 10-25; calibration sessions 10/26-10/29; official rating freeze 10/30; comms to ICs 11/03.
- Sensitive roles: we will flag a small list of roles (contractor-facing, exec-facing, payroll/finance privileged). HR will own redaction and restricted access list; managers will receive anonymized identifiers rather than names for those cases. Sensitive list attached as sensitive_roles_list.csv.
- Forms: new short manager feedback form (1 page) + calibration rubric. Managers get editable and PDF versions.
- Comms: draft manager email and FAQ attached (manager_communication_draft_v2.txt).

Requests: 
1) Neha — can you confirm redaction rules and evidence/retention needs so we can finalize the packet for Legal?
2) Laura & Karthik — review the timeline and manager toolkit; flag any business-critical exceptions (teams who need extended windows or special PII rules).
3) Olga — can you own the delivery plan for managers (training session + 30-min office hours)?

Please reply with edits inline. If we agree, I'll loop Legal and an external consultant for a quick read on the redaction process. Target to finalize by 9/10 so we can publish the manager packet the week of 9/13.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Engineering Productivity
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026_review_packet_v1.docx (docx), sensitive_roles_list.csv (csv), manager_communication_draft_v2.txt (text)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: 2026 annual review: timeline, templates, and sensitive-role protocol

Maya —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick confirmations and a few edits: 

- Redaction rules: Legal (looping Ben) recommends we never include personally identifiable information (PII) in any shared CIF/CSV that circulates beyond HR. For the sensitive_roles_list.csv we should use internal IDs and role descriptions only; names removed. HR will keep the mapping in a restricted directory with HSM-backed access logs. See attached redactions_guidelines.pdf for specifics.
- Data retention: review artifacts stored for 24 months by default with audit logs. If a manager needs longer for a specific case, they should raise a request with HR (we'll add a short form link in the packet).
- EU considerations: any names for EU employees must be redacted for manager-only drafts until release; this affects a couple of product leads in Dublin — Laura, can you confirm which teams?
- Manager training: we recommend two 45-minute calibration rehearsals (one for new managers). Olga can host office hours.

Ben — can you confirm this approach is consistent with our standard employee-data clauses? If yes, Ben can provide a short paragraph for the manager FAQ about why we redact and how managers can request access.

I'll update the packet and return v1.1.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Director, People Experience
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: 2026 annual review: timeline, templates, and sensitive-role protocol

Thanks — this looks sensible. A couple of manager-side asks: 

- Calibration windows: can we lock a hard deadline for managers to submit initial ratings (10/25) and make late submissions only via an exceptions form? Late inputs really complicate calibration.
- International exceptions: I confirm two Dublin leads (product infra) will need names redacted in manager docs until we publish final results due to local counsel guidance. I'll send a short list to HR directly.
- Metrics and promotion notes: can the manager form include a checkbox to indicate "Promotion under consideration" so we can ensure calibration includes promo bandwidth? That will help Talent Planning.

Also — can we plan a 30-min recording for managers who can't attend live calibration? Olga, could you draft the agenda and confirm recording logistics?

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Joan Harris <joan.harris@peopleadvisors.co>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.s@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: 2026 annual review: timeline, templates, and sensitive-role protocol

Maya/Neha/Laura —

Appreciate the invite. A few practical suggestions from our playbook that may be useful: 
1) Manager scripts: keep the initial manager comms to one paragraph + 3 bullets. Provide a 90-second "what to say" script for managers delivering ratings to affected ICs.
2) Anonymized calibration packet: replace names with ID codes and include a 1-line summary of limiting-context (e.g., "subject to sensitive-customer access").
3) Training: recommend one live calibration plus one dry-run with anonymized case studies — helps reduce bias and surfacing edge cases.

Attached is a short sample manager script and a redaction checklist. Happy to join calibration sessions if helpful (we charge a nominal hourly fee; I can send a statement of work if you want).

Best,
Joan Harris
Principal Consultant
PeopleAdvisors

All —

Good alignment here. Summary / decisions and next steps: 

Decisions:
- Use internal IDs for sensitive_roles_list.csv; HR to maintain mapping in a restricted Drive path with HSM-logged access. (Neha + Ben to finalize wording in redactions_guidelines.pdf)
- Manager submission deadline locked: 2026-10-25 23:59 PT. Late submissions require an exceptions form.
- EU names: Laura to send the two Dublin lead identifiers to HR by EOD Monday 9/13.
- Manager toolkit: include "Promotion under consideration" checkbox on the manager form; Olga to add recording and office hours slots.

Action owners and deadlines:
- Neha: update packet and redactions guidance -> send v1.1 by 9/10 EOD.
- Olga: draft manager training agenda + recordable slide deck by 9/15.
- Karthik: ensure engineering managers have the editable form in Confluence and that the export to HR strips names for sensitive IDs (blocker if not ready by 9/20).
- Laura: supply Dublin identifiers by 9/13.
- Maya: finalize timeline and publish manager packet for distribution on 9/13 if all items are green.

If there are no objections, I'll mark this thread as the canonical timeline and publish the manager packet on Monday.

Thanks for quick reviews — please add any last-minute blockers inline.

Maya
